planning.setup.title: Project creation
planning.setup.unauthorized: The operator has not authorized creating this project

planning.turn.interrupted: The turn was interrupted: its result is unknown and it is not repeated. Confirm the stopped writer in {run}.
planning.turn.plan: It proposes a plan for the target phase.
planning.turns.empty: No turns yet. Write the first message below.
preferences.conflict: Preferences changed in another window. The current values are shown; review them and save again.
preferences.invalid: The stored preferences are invalid. The interface uses English and new work is refused until you save them again.
preferences.lede: Languages of this installation. They apply to every project and window of this service.
preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.ui.hint: Interface and the service's own messages. Work already admitted keeps the language it was admitted with.
preferences.unavailable: Preferences could not be read; the interface keeps its last language.
preferences.work.hint: Starting value for the work language of projects created or onboarded later. It never changes existing projects.
preparation.authorize: I authorize these files, commands, installation, network mode and commit inside the child.
preparation.confirm_stopped: Check and confirm the stopped writer
preparation.journal: See captures and the full journal
preparation.journal_evidence: Confirmed plan, captures and preparation journal
preparation.lede.django: After the documentation commit, this recipe creates the environment, the project and the base app, validates its tools and makes a technical commit. Tasks are enabled when it finishes.
preparation.lede.typescript: After the documentation commit, this recipe writes the initial manifest (package.json, lock, tsconfig, scripts, a module and its test), installs the lock with npm ci, runs the profile validations and makes a technical commit. Tasks are enabled when it finishes.
preparation.mode.django.hint: The cache and the environment stay inside the child. A failure stops the preparation and keeps its bytes; no command is repeated automatically.
preparation.mode.django.network: Network: download pinned wheels from PyPI
preparation.mode.django.offline: Offline: use local wheels and the child's cache
preparation.mode.typescript.hint: node_modules stays inside the child; the npm cache is the operator's and with network it is also written. A failure stops the preparation and keeps its bytes; no command is repeated automatically.
preparation.mode.typescript.network: Network: download the pinned lock from the npm registry
preparation.mode.typescript.offline: Offline: use only the npm cache declared by the operator
preparation.plan_evidence: Versions, lock, public environment, network, limits and commit
preparation.prepared: {recipe} prepared. You can continue with the tasks of the phase.
preparation.prepared_generic: Project prepared. You can continue with the tasks of the phase.
preparation.review_retry: Review a new intent from step {step}

project.creation.body: Define it with the reviewer from a brief: the drafts are applied to the folder with your confirmation and, on acceptance, the harness makes the root commit with phase P001.
project.creation.pending: This project is not created yet

prompts.confirm: I confirm activating this saved version in the {scope} scope.
prompts.flow.activation: Activating a template affects later uses; it does not start the operation.
prompts.flow.bootstrap: Historical template of the v1 creation, retired. New projects use define-project.
prompts.flow.close: Review template of the phase check. After READY, closure and archive need their own confirmation.
prompts.flow.reconcile: Template of the documentation reconciliation task: it is executed, reviewed and confirmed like a task; afterwards the documentation base is adopted by hash.
prompts.hint: Hierarchy: base, profile and project; each level replaces the previous one. Activating affects future attempts of runs in progress or new ones. Stopped runs keep their catalog when resumed. Editing grants no permissions.
prompts.inherit.core: This scope affects other projects that inherit the global base.
prompts.inherit.profile: This scope affects other projects that inherit this profile.
prompts.rollback: Rollback: copy to a new version
prompts.title: Versioned prompts
prompts.valid: Valid variables. The content was neither saved nor activated.
prompts.variables: Required variables: {variables}. No other variables are allowed.
register.creation_disabled.title: Creation disabled by the operator
register.lede: Choose a new folder or register an existing checkout with the operator composition.
register.no_root.body: First save the parent folder where children are created.
register.no_root.title: Choose a projects folder
register.no_toml_roots.body: This authority is independent of the folder chosen for new children.
register.no_toml_roots.title: No TOML roots to register existing folders
register.pending.body: The exact submission is kept. Resending it returns its result without duplicating the operation.
register.pending.title: Confirmation waiting for its response
register.unavailable.body: It needs local-config-3/4/5/6/7 with registration and compositions.
register.unavailable.title: This service does not support registering projects
registry.agents.inherited_hint: Provider, model and effort of the reviewer and the executor provider are inherited from the service. The executor policy is defined below.
registry.authority: Permission ceiling (optional JSON: layer → kind → targets)
registry.authority_invalid: The permission ceiling is not valid JSON.
registry.bootstrap: Allow creating the project from scratch in this folder
registry.bootstrap_forbidden: Allow creating the project from scratch in this folder (the operator does not authorize it)
registry.change_hint: The root does not change. Changing the version invalidates the jobs admitted with the previous one; with unfinished jobs the change is rejected.
registry.documents_hint: Every project uses the unified documentation contract: instructions, diagrams, flows and an archive per phase.
registry.environment_hint: Environment paths and values stay in the TOML; here they are only named.
registry.not_composed: It does not compose with the current TOML: {diagnostic}
registry.other_model: Another model accepted by the CLI
registry.presets_missing: Compatible presets for both roles are missing. The operator must declare them in the service configuration.
registry.presets_unsupported: Changing providers per project needs local-config-5/6/7/8 and operator presets. This configuration keeps the service pair.
registry.project_id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore. It cannot match a TOML project or a removed one.
registry.read_failed: The registry could not be read: {error}
registry.retire_hint: The project stops being available and its runs become read only. The history is kept and the id is not reused; the folder becomes free for another registration.
registry.reviewed: I have reviewed the row, the changes and the frozen versions.
registry.reviewed_retire: I have reviewed the removal; the history is kept and the id is not reused.
registry.reviewer_decides: The reviewer will decide the executor's concrete model and effort, with a reason, in each task and revision. Saving invalidates plans not yet accepted.
registry.reviewer_toml: The reviewer ({provider}) plans with the model and effort the TOML sets.
registry.root_hint.multiple: Real absolute path, without symbolic links, inside one of the authorized roots:
registry.root_hint.single: Real absolute path, without symbolic links, inside the authorized root:
registry.title: Registry
registry.trust_confirmed: Confirmed on registration for this root
registry.unfinished: The checkout has unfinished jobs ({jobs}). Wait until they finish or reconcile them: the server will reject the change.
run.attempt.evidence: Selection, result, review and reported consumption
run.checkpoint: A commit keeps a checkpoint of the reviewed work; integration into the target branch is still pending.
run.commit_confirm: I have reviewed the evidence of this version and confirm the commit.
run.diff.discontinuous: The page read does not continue the diff shown. Load it again.
run.diff.label: Reviewed diff of revision {number}
run.outcome.bootstrap: Documentation creation confirmed. The initial commit and the first phase are shown in the project summary.
run.outcome.committed: Reviewed content saved in the commit shown.
run.outcome.eligible: Content accepted and eligible for commit.
run.outcome.export: Documentation export confirmed by its diff. The result and the commit are shown in the phase history.
run.recovery.bootstrap: Afterwards reconcile the confirmed bootstrap in the project summary.
run.recovery.confirm: I explicitly confirm that the previous writer is stopped.
run.recovery.discovery: The proposal stays unknown; asking for another one needs its own action.
run.recovery.export: Afterwards preview the export in the phase to reconcile the kept intent.
run.recovery.lease: An expired lease does not prove that the writer finished. Check that it stopped before releasing the checkout.
run.recovery.task: Afterwards you can revalidate without repeating the executor.
run.retry_confirm: Retry the executor? It uses the correction budget and may modify the work.
run.unregistered.body: Its evidence is kept, but it has no page in this interface.
run.unregistered.title: The run belongs to a checkout without a registered project
runs.empty.body: Queue a task so the planner, the executor and the reviewer work on it.
runs.empty.title: No runs yet
session.check_failed: Could not check the session. Check the local service.
session.closed: Session closed. Work already authorized continues.
session.expired_pending: Session closed or expired. Pending actions are not repeated automatically.
session.instructions: Open the private file the service named at startup and paste its key here. The session lasts eight hours; restarting the service closes it.
session.login_failed: Could not sign in. Check the key and the service.
session.logout_failed: Could not confirm the sign-out. Try again or stop the service.
session.rate_limited: Wait a minute before trying again.
session.title: Sign in
session.until_hint: The session expires after eight hours or when the service restarts
settings.lede: See the effective agents and change their selection in the project registry, if the service offers presets. The reviewer decides the executor's model and effort for each task. The operator sets executables and environments.
settings.source.registry: Registered from the interface; registry version {version}.
settings.source.toml: Declared in the operator TOML; it is not edited from the interface.
stats.attempts.hint: One row per attempt, from the oldest to the most recent, with the provenance of each value:
stats.attempts.title: Attempts
stats.backfill: The backfill is explicit ({command}); until then they count in no total.
stats.chart.validations_phase: OK and KO validations per phase
stats.chart.validations_project: OK and KO validations per project
stats.consumption.hint.day: Total tokens per UTC day the attempt started, from the oldest to the most recent. Only days with attempts; an empty circle marks a day whose attempts report no tokens (no data, not zero).
stats.consumption.hint.phase: Total tokens per phase, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.consumption.hint.provider: Total tokens per provider, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.consumption.hint.reported_model: Output tokens per model the provider reports (Claude). Codex does not report a model; its attempts do not appear here.
stats.consumption.hint.requested_effort: Total tokens per requested effort, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.consumption.hint.requested_model: Total tokens per requested model, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.consumption.hint.role: Total tokens per role, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.consumption.hint.root: Total tokens per project, from highest to lowest. Raw input is not added up: its meaning depends on the provider.
stats.favorites.hint: What each attempt requested (frozen selection), not what the provider says it used.
stats.lede.all: Consumption and quality of the agents' work in every project of this service.
stats.lede.project: Consumption and quality of the agents' work in this project.
stats.lede.tokens: Tokens are those each provider reports: “no data” means that no attempt reported them, not zero. The cost is the reported API equivalent, not an invoice or a quota.
stats.read_failed: The metrics could not be read: {error}
stats.tasks.hint: Revisions = executions after the first one. Tokens include failed attempts. Tests: latest validation of the task.
stats.tests.hint: Each validation of each task, revalidations included. OK: every command correct and no new JUnit failure. Validations do not store their time, so the trend is read per phase, not per day.
stats.tile.attempts_note: {terminal} with the provider total · {messages} by messages (partial) · {absent} without reported usage
stats.tile.time_note: Sum of attempts, not elapsed time
stats.tile.turns_note: Reported (Claude) and derived (Codex) are not added together
stats.without_metrics.one: {count} resolved attempt has no metrics: it is earlier than the capture.
stats.without_metrics.other: {count} resolved attempts have no metrics: they are earlier than the capture.

task.empty.title: This task has no runs yet
task.lede: Task of phase {phase}. Each run keeps its contract, its attempts and its evidence.
task.queue_again: Queue a new run of this task

task_form.not_in_source: {id} is not in {path}; write the contract by hand.
task_form.notes_hint: They are frozen in the contract and reach the planner, the executor and the reviewer. They do not widen paths, commands or permissions.

task_form.preparation_required_generic: Prepare the project from the creation page or the project summary before queuing tasks.

tests.durations_hint: Durations observed per test; they are not added up as a total time. The results belong to the report and its capture status.
tests.no_cases: No cases observed on this page.
tests.no_report: No JUnit report is declared for this command. No per-test detail.
tests.title: Validations and tests
work.hint: Language of the documentation, plans and code comments that the agents write for this project. It is fixed when you confirm and never changes; the interface language is a separate global preference.
work.missing.blocked: Unfinished or pending work blocks the confirmation: {items}
work.missing.body: New work for this project is refused until you choose its work language. Existing files are kept as they are: nothing is translated or renamed.
work.missing.check: I understand that the work language never changes after confirming.
work.missing.title: Work language not confirmed
work.preview.default: Global default when reviewing: {language}. The value confirmed is the one chosen above.
work.preview.existing: This folder already has {language} as its work language; it is kept.
work.settings.title: Work language
workspace.pending.body: Repeating it sends exactly the same content with the same key, so it does not create a duplicate job.
workspace.pending.title: Submission without a confirmed response
profile.pending: A confirmation has no acknowledged response. Review and resend the same request.
profile.proposal_hint: Review commands, tools, evidence and the preparation plan. Editing creates a new draft; adoption does not prepare or activate it.
profile.name: Profile name
profile.advanced: Edit complete profile, commands and evidence
profile.adopt_hint: Adoption confirms the saved proposal shown below. Save edits first; commands that contradict the documents require a new documentary turn.
profile.confirm_exact: I confirm this exact preview and its restrictions.
profile.order: Documents are committed first. Save the private configuration, confirm preparation, review its evidence, then activate. Tasks remain blocked until activation.
profile.conflict: The saved version changed. Your edits and base are retained; explicitly reload the current base before trying again.
profile.reload_base: Discard edits and reload current base
profile.references: Saved and active versions; accepted profile
profile.prepare_hint: Preparation uses the saved configuration and the accepted plan. Review files, commands, dependencies, network and executor scope before confirming.
profile.adopted: Profile draft adopted. Save another draft to change it before the documentary commit.
assistance.title: Optional configuration assistance
assistance.hint: Assistance uses the active clients. Review the exact context before authorizing a turn. Applying a proposal only changes your draft; saving and activation require their own confirmations.
assistance.executor: Executor: inspect in a private workspace
assistance.documents: Include AGENTS, specification, architecture and decisions
assistance.authorize: I authorize this exact turn and scope
assistance.pending: The response is unacknowledged. Repeating this exact request reads the original turn; it never launches another one.
assistance.profile_hint: Prepare a later edit from the current committed documentation. Profile changes require a documentary update first; technical changes require new preparation. Other projects retain their own configuration.
assistance.scope_read: Read only. The turn receives only the candidate and selected context.
assistance.scope_write: Only the new private workspace may be written. No commands, installations or network are authorized.
assistance.failed: The turn did not produce a valid result. Your draft and active configuration are preserved.
configuration.mode.apply_pending: Change confirmed: apply when current work finishes. The active configuration stays in use until then.
configuration.activation_scope: Applying configuration changes the agent clients and settings used by new work. It does not prepare a project's technical profile (each project's Preparation) and it does not update My Harness (scripts/install).
configuration.live.pending_hint: New work keeps using the active configuration until the switch. Resolve or wait for:
configuration.live.now: Applies now, without restarting the service: no work is running.
configuration.live.will_wait: Applies without restarting, as soon as this current work finishes or is resolved:
configuration.live.restart: These settings take effect only after restarting the service: {fields}.
configuration.live.refused: The candidate cannot be applied. The active configuration is unchanged; correct these settings and review again:
configuration.live.failed: The confirmed change {id} could not be applied at the switch and was withdrawn. The previous configuration is still active:
configuration.live.already_failing: already unavailable with the active configuration
